scenes.a_jerry: 1950s aerospace engineering office: a confident athletic engineer father in a white shirt and tie, a Caltech graduate, bent over rocket and missile guidance blueprints at a drafting table, slide rule in hand
scenes.a_blackboard: 1950s living room: an engineer father drawing an atom with orbiting electrons and a resistor symbol on a small blackboard, a chubby dark-haired boy with a round friendly face of about seven listening wide-eyed, electronic parts on the table
scenes.a_intercom: 1960s suburban backyards at dusk: a chubby dark-haired boy with a round friendly face of about ten stringing wires between neighboring houses for a homemade intercom, other kids leaning out of bedroom windows with handsets, joyful
scenes.a_award: 1960s school science fair gymnasium: a chubby dark-haired boy with a round friendly face of about thirteen proudly standing beside a large homemade binary calculator made of ten circuit boards with many transistors and little lights, a blue ribbon pinned on it, older teenagers watching
scenes.a_paper: Late 1960s teenage bedroom at night with the door closed: a chubby dark-haired boy with a round friendly face of about seventeen drawing careful computer circuit schematics on graph paper, chip data books stacked around, desk lamp
scenes.b_creamsoda: 1970 suburban garage: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face and a younger skinny teen friend soldering a homemade computer full of switches and little lights on a workbench, empty cream soda bottles everywhere
scenes.b_bottles: 1970 sunny suburban street: two teenage boys riding bicycles loaded with bags of empty soda bottles toward a supermarket, laughing
scenes.b_sidewalk: Autumn 1970, a quiet suburban sidewalk in front of a house: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face and a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair sitting side by side on the curb, talking animatedly with their hands, late afternoon golden light, the start of a friendship
scenes.b_tapes: Early 1970s cluttered record shop in Berkeley: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face and a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair digging through boxes of unlabeled reel-to-reel tapes and lyric booklets, excited
scenes.b_headphones: Early 1970s bedroom: a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair lying on his bed with big headphones on, eyes closed, a reel-to-reel tape deck spinning on the shelf, lyric sheets scattered
scenes.c_metronome: Late 1960s teenage bedroom workbench: a chubby dark-haired boy with a round friendly face of about seventeen grinning mischievously while taping a ticking electronic metronome to a bundle of big batteries with the labels torn off
scenes.c_principal: Late 1960s high school: a brave middle-aged principal in a suit running across the school field clutching a ticking device of batteries and wires tightly to his chest, students watching from the windows
scenes.c_jail: 1960s juvenile detention room: a chubby dark-haired boy with a round friendly face of about seventeen secretly showing other teenage detainees how to connect the ceiling fan wires to the window bars, mischievous grin
scenes.c_sheet: Early 1970s suburban backyard: three teenage boys and a cheerful middle-aged mother painting on a huge tie-dyed green and white bedsheet laid on the grass, the painting seen only from the back edge, laughter
scenes.c_tv: Early 1970s college dorm lounge: a group of students watching a fuzzy television, one student standing on one leg holding the rabbit-ear antenna, while a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face in the back secretly presses a button in his pocket, trying not to laugh
scenes.c_keynote: 2000s large keynote stage: a grey-bearded man in a black turtleneck and jeans standing on stage telling a funny story with a bent pose, a huge blank screen behind him, audience laughing in the dark
scenes.d_magazine: 1971 Sunday afternoon kitchen: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face reading a magazine article at the kitchen table, eyes wide with excitement, reaching for a wall telephone
scenes.d_library: 1971 Sunday: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face and a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair slipping through a rarely locked side door into a quiet empty science library, looking around conspiratorially
scenes.d_journal: Close-up of young hands flipping through a thick technical journal in a library stack, pages full of tables and waveform diagrams (no readable text), dramatic light
scenes.d_build: 1971 Berkeley dorm room at night: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face soldering a small homemade digital tone device with a numeric keypad, while a dorm mate with perfect pitch listens closely with eyes closed
scenes.d_firstcall: Early 1970s family kitchen at night: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face and a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair shouting excitedly into a telephone handset connected to a small box with a keypad, both laughing
scenes.d_booth: Early 1970s public phone booth at night: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face talking into the receiver with a pompous serious face and exaggerated accent, a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair squeezed beside him suppressing laughter
scenes.e_assemble: Early 1970s kitchen table: a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair assembling small blue boxes with numeric keypads and battery packs into neat cases, a notepad with cost calculations beside him
scenes.e_dorm: Early 1970s college dorm room: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face and a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair demonstrating a small blue box connected to a telephone and a speaker to a crowd of amazed students
scenes.e_pizza: Early 1970s pizza parlor in Sunnyvale: a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair leaning over to pitch a small blue box to a group of tough-looking young men at the next table, a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face watching nervously
scenes.e_gun: Night parking lot outside a pizza parlor: a tough man sitting in a car pulling a pistol from under the seat and pointing it at a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair, who slowly hands over a small blue box, a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face frozen behind him, tense but not gory
scenes.e_callback: Early 1970s payphone: a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair calling a number written on a scrap of paper, puzzled and frustrated expression
scenes.e_partners: Early 1970s garage workbench at dusk: a chubby, slightly hunched young man of about twenty with dark wavy hair and a friendly round face absorbed in soldering an invention while a skinny intense teenage boy of about sixteen with long dark hair beside him holds the finished device up to the light like a product, imagining selling it
